target.title: fix(openai): widen local image endpoint loopback check to full 127.0.0.0/8 range
target.body:
## What

Changed `shouldAllowPrivateImageEndpoint` from exact `http://127.0.0.1:` prefix match to `http://127.` prefix match, covering the full 127.0.0.0/8 loopback range.

## Why

The check only matched `127.0.0.1`, missing other valid loopback addresses. Containerized image generation providers (e.g. Ollama, self-hosted endpoints) may bind to `127.0.0.2` or other addresses in the 127/8 range. This is a QA-only code path (requires `OPENCLAW_QA_ALLOW_LOCAL_IMAGE_PROVIDER=1`) but the detection logic should still be correct.

## Evidence

- Affected file: `extensions/openai/image-generation-provider.ts`
- The `https://` path is already excluded (only http:// prefixes are checked)
- The canonical `isLoopbackIpAddress` in `packages/net-policy/src/ip.ts` covers the full 127/8 range
